title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes + version bumps
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Unify SDK behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go: standardize auth token refresh and pluggable retry policies, bring streaming API ergonomics and event names to parity, apply small API ergonomic changes (context managers, consistent sync/async names, helper factories), add tests and docs, and bump package versions for parity. Motivation: teams running multi-language clients reported subtle differences in auth handling (early token expiry + double-refresh), inconsistent retry semantics, and divergent streaming event shapes between SDKs which complicate integrations and server routing. This PR implements a shared behavior: 1) centralized token refresh hook (with backoff and single-refresh-in-flight guarantee), 2) configurable retry-policy interface with default idempotent-safe policy, 3) streaming API event parity (events: "open","data","error","done" across SDKs) and a uniform client-side helper for chunk parsing, 4) ergonomics: contextmanager/async context for Python client, unified method names (stream_messages / streamResponses -> stream), and clearer factory helpers for auth+client creation. Also includes type fixes and small runtime adjustments to ensure feature parity, CI test updates, and version bumps in package manifests. Checklist: [x] implement shared auth hook, [x] add retry policy interface and defaults, [x] align streaming event names and helpers, [x] update tests across SDKs, [x] docs + migration notes, [x] bump versions (py/ts/go). Related: ENG-1482 tracking SDK parity work. Migration notes: consumers should replace previous streaming helpers with unified stream() helpers and update any custom retry hooks to the new interface; server-side compatibility maintained through backwards-compatible event aliasing for one release. See docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/migration-auth-retries and CHANGELOG for detailed notes.

release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go): unified auth token refresh behavior with single-refresh-in-flight and configurable backoff.
- Introduced pluggable RetryPolicy interface and default idempotent-safe policy.
- Streaming: unified event names (open, data, error, done) and cross-SDK helpers for chunk parsing; backwards-compatible aliases provided for one release.
- Ergonomics: consistent sync/async method names, Python context manager support, and simplified factory helpers.
- Tests and e2e coverage extended across SDKs.
- Version bumps for Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK packages.
notes_for_maintainers: Follow-up items: remove streaming aliases in next major if no migration issues reported; consider adding a shared SDK testing harness for auth/streaming behaviors (ENG-1520).
